target.title: fix(discord): hydrate missing reply references
target.body:
Closes #105862

## What Problem This Solves

A normal Discord reply can arrive with a valid `message_reference.message_id` but without a nested `referenced_message`. OpenClaw currently re-fetches the inbound reply, but if Discord's REST response also omits the nested payload, downstream reply context still cannot see the referenced message body.

## Why This Change Was Made

Preserve the existing inbound hydration first. When that successful REST result still lacks `referenced_message`, fetch the referenced message directly using the reference's channel and message IDs and attach it through the existing Discord `Message` wrapper path.

The fallback remains limited to ordinary Discord replies. Known-deleted references and forwarded messages are unchanged, cross-channel references use their own channel ID, and API failures continue normal inbound delivery without logging referenced content.

## User Impact

Agents can receive the bounded quoted-message context for native Discord replies even when Discord omits the nested referenced payload from both the Gateway event and the hydrated reply response.

## Evidence

Final-head validation after rebasing onto current `main`:

- Candidate head: `9bf4873045`; rebased onto `origin/main` at `1aff6da827`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.hydration.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-utils.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.preflight.test.ts` — 3 files and 106 tests passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.hydration.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.hydration.test.ts` — passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed.
- `check:changed` reached the repository-wide TypeScript LOC ratchet and failed on baseline drift already present in current `main`; none of the reported files are touched by this PR. No unrelated baseline changes were added here.

The patch has source-level and mocked REST proof, including same-channel and cross-channel reference hydration. A live Discord capture is still unavailable: this machine has no configured Discord account or token, so the requested redacted Gateway/REST payload and agent-context capture cannot be produced locally without access to a real test setup. This limitation is stated explicitly rather than substituting mocked output for live evidence.
